dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a concave spline curvature, typical of a falcate profile, with the most significant inward curve occurring at the lower third of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a smooth pixel radius transition between the leading and trailing margins.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour presents a steep incline of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The maximum pixel base width is roughly 1.3 times the maximum vertical pixel height measured from the base to the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon displays a pronounced structural convexity with a uniform radius of curvature from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum profile, characterized by a low length-to-thickness ratio as it extends from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct obtuse interior angle is measurable at the pixel coordinate where the convex melon slope meets the base of the rostrum.
